messages:
alec_cs: Heads-up — NimbusRetail onboarding: noticed p95 flicker to ~1.6s during midday spikes (SLO 0.9s). Renewal in 28 days. Want a short, actionable perf plan (quantize/model-mix/routing) we can propose in renewal call.
priya_se: Can we split by intent? UI autocomplete vs batch scoring? Also need median seq and KV cache rate.
alec_cs: Quick pull: UI autocomplete 70% requests, median seq 120, p95 seq 420. Batch scoring 20%, median seq 900. KV hit ~9%. Customer feedback: "search feels laggy at peak."
hugo_ml: Clear candidate for hybrid routing + quantization. Suggest routing UI to a compact int4 model (redwood-1b-int4) and keeping heavy scoring on redwood-7b-q4f16. Also try a 3B q4_int8 canary for mixed routes. Need their 500-ui prompt eval to measure BLEU/ROUGE-ish metric delta.
tara_pm: Guardrails: 12% canary for 72h, monitor p95, error spikes, and customer QA votes. Rollback if quality delta >1.8% or user complaints >3 in 24h.
deploy-bot: routing: canary created -> nimbus_ui_canary_2026_03, 12% -> redwood-1b-int4, fallback -> redwood-3b-q4_int8 -> redwood-7b. Metrics: https://deploys.internal/nimbus_ui_canary_2026_03
lina_am: I'll brief the AMs and draft a 1-slide explanation of expected gains + simple quick feedback prompts for CS to capture subjective snappiness.
priya_se: Routing snippet I'll stage to staging cluster tonight. Bench plan: run ramped concurrency 5->50 rps, mixed seq distribution, collect p50/p95 and cpu/gpu utilization.
hugo_ml: I'll run the eval overnight and push pass/fail to the canary gate. If quality within bounds, we can propose phased ramp tied to latency gains.
tara_pm: Action items: priya stage + bench (EOD), hugo run eval (overnight), lina prep AM note (tomorrow AM). Sync 09:30 to review.
alec_cs: Thanks — adding prefix-cache suggestion: enable prefix caching with TTL 5m for UI flows; should cut token spend and give extra latency headroom.
priya_se: Added cache flag to staged rule. Will include bench delta.
alec_cs: Perfect. Will include these recommendations in renewal playbook as "performance remediation option" and call them out in the next customer touch.
